forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+description: 'Remove the llama-agent chat crate and make Claude the only chat executor. Also remove the `sah model` CLI command and the kanban AI panel, and collapse the chat model configuration to a hardcoded Claude executor. SCOPE LIMIT: this touches the chat agent only. The embedding stack stays — `llama-common`, `llama-embedding`, `model-loader`, `ane-embedding`, `model-embedding`, `swissarmyhammer-embedding`, the `../llama-cpp-rs` fork, and the embedding model YAMLs (`nomic-embed-code.yaml`, `qwen-embedding.yaml`) are NOT part of this work. `llama-common` must stay: `llama-embedding`, `model-loader`, and `ane-embedding` all depend on it. `acp-conformance` stays; it is a generic ACP suite and only loses its llama-agent dev-dependency.'
+name: Drop llama-agent, Claude only
